title: Ops scenario rehearsal harness for privileged fixes
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a lightweight rehearsal harness that lets oncall and support engineers execute privileged runbook steps in a sandboxed replay environment. The goal is to enable dry-run and semi-live rehearsals of escalation steps (DB migrations, emergency config flips, emergency secrets rotation) with auditable decision points and telemetry so teams can validate runbooks and shorten MTTR without touching production state. This ticket focuses on the core orchestration, RBAC gating, and a minimal CLI + web UI for kicking off rehearsals.
proposed_solution: Introduce a Rehearsal Service that accepts a typed runbook (existing runbooks-as-tasks schema) and executes it against emulated targets. Key components: 1) a sandbox adapter layer that maps privileged actions to safe no-op or staging equivalents; 2) a permissioned rehearsal API with canary gating (who can rehearse which steps); 3) telemetry hooks that record decision points and simulated outcomes; 4) a short-lived policy token system for timeboxed elevated privileges during semi-live tests. The service will integrate with current runbook registry and the admin console for playback and audit.
acceptance_criteria: Rehearsal service can ingest an existing runbook JSON and produce a step-by-step dry-run trace
Sandbox adapters implemented for at least three privileged action types (DB schema change, config toggle, secret rotate) that do not modify production state
RBAC gating enforced via single-sign-on group membership and audit logs stored for 90 days
CLI and minimal UI allow an engineer to start, pause, and mark decisions at runbook steps
Telemetry emitted to ops-dash with per-step latency and simulated result codes
Automated smoke tests exercising happy path and two failure modes are present in CI
technical_notes: Prefer adapter pattern: each privileged action implements SandboxAdapter with methods: simulate(), validate(), optionally apply() (apply is blocked unless service token present)
Use feature-flagged rollout behind 'rehearsal-service' flag; default off for orgs
Retention: store rehearsal traces in encrypted S3 bucket; redact any secret values before persisting
Telemetry schema: step_id, runbook_id, actor, decision, simulated_status, latency_ms, trace_id
Security tradeoff: semi-live rehearsals require temporary tokens; minimize blast radius by scoping tokens to staging endpoints only
